title: Demo A: Retrieval-assisted campus FAQ (fictional)
text: We propose a retrieval-assisted question answering model for campus frequently asked questions. The method combines sparse retrieval with a small language model and source-grounded responses. The dataset contains 800 manually reviewed campus questions from one institution. We train on 500 questions and evaluate on a held-out test set of 300 questions. Compared to a baseline keyword search, the model achieves 84% answer accuracy versus 72% for the baseline on the same test set. A bootstrap confidence interval for model accuracy is 80% to 88%. Source code and random seed details are available in the supplementary material. Limitations include a single institution, a small sample, and possible annotation bias. Future work should evaluate generalization to other institutions and multilingual questions.

title: Demo B: Multilingual campus assistant (fictional)
text: We propose a multilingual transformer model for student support questions. The method fine-tunes a pretrained model on a dataset of 1200 English and Hindi question-answer pairs. The experiment uses a held-out split with 240 questions. Results show an F1 score of 0.81 and a recall of 0.86 on the internal evaluation. Participants report improved access to student services in a follow-up survey. The model is evaluated at one campus. Limitations include language imbalance and limited generalization to other educational settings. Future work will investigate broader language coverage.
